fields.description: What the customer sees at checkout, e.g. Express Delivery. Also the identifier stored on their order.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: ETA text shown under the title, e.g. 1-2 business days.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The provider's identifier for the carrier service to quote and book, e.g. a Shiprocket courier id.
fields.label: Service Code

fields.description: Carrier name for display and reporting. Not used to quote.
fields.label: Carrier

fields.description: Added on top of the live carrier rate, to cushion quote-versus-invoice drift.
fields.label: Markup %

fields.description: Flat amount added after the markup.
fields.label: Handling Fee

fields.description: Optional. Prices this option by cart-value or weight bands instead of the live carrier rate. A band always wins over a live rate, and its free-shipping tier is what makes this option free.
fields.label: Shipping Rule

fields.description: Charged when no band covers the cart and the carrier gives no live quote. Always set this: an option with no band, no live rate and no backup charge is hidden at checkout rather than shown as free.
fields.label: Backup Charge
